segments.text: Run the day shift of 11 nurses in a 22-bed adult ICU with 34 nurses on the roster.
Cut handover time from about 40 minutes to 25 minutes for 22 patients with a one-page sheet and a 12-hour look-back.
Counted 212 discharges over six months: patients were held 2.4 days past need on average, 61% of them waiting for a ward bed.
Since 2023, run a Sunday group for new ICU nurses across the district; 34 nurses have come through it.
Critical care nursing certificate, Southern Critical Care Nursing Association, 2021.
Charge Nurse, Adult Intensive Care, An Khang General Hospital (February 2023 to present). I run the day shift of 11 nurses on a 22-bed adult ICU.
ICU Staff Nurse, An Khang General Hospital, same unit (July 2018 to January 2023).
During the 2022 dengue surge, when I was an ICU Staff Nurse, our 22-bed unit stayed full for 12 days. On the worst morning 9 patients were waiting for a bed and 3 were being ventilated by hand.
Since becoming Charge Nurse in February 2023, I have run the day shift of 11 nurses. In 2024 I changed how we hand over: it now takes 25 minutes instead of about 40.
